If the party ask him questions will be THE Light of Truth, a litmus for the party to gauge the lies they have known. He will, after questioning explain his relationship to THE Calamity (Xingrelleth) but he will know not how to stop her and demonstrate that he, though very long ago, has tried. He will also tell the party that it is through Xin that the undead are bourne to be.
